office: Representative, Taguig City Lone District (2nd Councilor District)
profileLabel: Mildly center-left economics; mildly protective on detention and speech (low confidence)
summary: Taguig representative with 81 principal-authored bills. Authored free check-ups for indigents, a national living wage commission, labor-provision protections, expanded senior and PWD discounts, and a travel-tax and athlete tax exemption. Also authored protections against hospital-bill detention, a malicious AI-media penalty and PNP modernization.
caveat: Civil-liberties score rests on two bills with opposing signals; bill text for the AI-media and PNP measures was not reviewed.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Free check-ups for indigents (-2), living wage commission and labor-provision bill (-2), senior and PWD discounts (-1), against travel-tax abolition and athlete tax exemptions (+2). Mild left lean on mixed pattern.
